sources.title: Amazon Associates Program Operating Agreement
sources.verifiedNotes: The agreement says Special Links must use the special tagged formats Amazon provides and requires the statement, ‘As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.’

sources.title: Associates Program Policies
sources.verifiedNotes: Program policies include Special Link formatting and PA API / Creators API content-use requirements. This is the primary policy source used for the link and automation gates.

sources.title: How do I build a simple text link to a specific item on Amazon?
sources.verifiedNotes: Amazon documents a product link format that uses an ASIN and Associate ID, and recommends using its link-building tools. The submitted short-link path values are not copied into the intended-ASIN field.

sources.title: FTC's Endorsement Guides: What People Are Asking
sources.verifiedNotes: FTC guidance says affiliate relationships should be disclosed clearly and conspicuously, close to recommendations and links; the guidance notes context matters and is not a safe harbor.

sources.title: How To use reports
sources.verifiedNotes: Amazon Associates reports surface clicks, ordered items, shipped items and conversions, with reports selectable by Tracking ID. No account report was supplied or accessed for this project.

sources.title: How to read the Order Report
sources.verifiedNotes: Amazon defines fields in the Order Report, including product-link clicks and product-link conversion. Project reporting fields remain blank until copied from an authorized first-party report with provenance.

sources.title: Are There Any Requirements to Use the Product Advertising API?
sources.verifiedNotes: Amazon says PA API use requires an open Associates account, compliance with the Operating Agreement, and application for PA API subject to its license. No API credentials or account were supplied.

sources.title: Build and submit a sitemap
sources.verifiedNotes: Google documents sitemap formats, root placement, and sitemap submission options. The shipped sitemap lists the public publication pages and guides.

sources.title: Get started with Search Console
sources.verifiedNotes: Google describes verifying site ownership, checking indexing, submitting a sitemap if desired, and using Search performance reports for query and traffic data. Search Console ownership is not verified here.

sources.title: Using custom workflows with GitHub Pages
sources.verifiedNotes: GitHub documents building and deploying static Pages artifacts with Actions. GitHub Pages does not run the Node analytics API included in this repository.

sources.title: CAN-SPAM Act: A Compliance Guide for Business
sources.verifiedNotes: FTC guidance describes commercial-email requirements, including a clear opt-out explanation and a functioning opt-out process. No signup form or email collection is enabled.

sources.title: Can I Check If My Links Are Tagging to My Account?
sources.verifiedNotes: Amazon describes checking the Store ID or Tracking ID in a generated link and says its Link Checker is for links created or modified outside Associates Central. The supplied links have not been tested in an enrolled Associates workflow.

sources.title: Observed Amazon page after individual re-open of submitted link 01
sources.verifiedNotes: Individually re-opened the exact submitted URL https://link.amazon/B04G1MEwY in the page reader on 2026-11-20. The normalized Amazon target path, visible page title, and breadcrumb category 'Air Fryers' are observations only. They do not confirm owner intent, the complete HTTP redirect chain, current listing details, or Special Link compliance/tracking.
